locations.notes: User Library + Projects are his actual work (samples, presets, sets). .alp packs are zip archives — fine as data, but scan contents before importing on the new install.
Live preferences are small files (Preferences.cfg etc.). Validate they are well-formed before reapply; a corrupt prefs file just makes Live crash on boot.
Peak/decoding caches and crash dumps are rebuilt on demand. Nothing restorable of value.
Live installs from his vendor installer. VST plugins (.dll/.vst3) are third-party binaries — reinstall from vendor installers only, never restore from the old drive.
